step1_figure.circuit_type: Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) Sensing Circuit for CMOS Image Sensor
step1_figure.description: Figure 17.33 shows the schematic of a first-order Delta-Sigma Modulator for sensing in CMOS imaging chips, which uses switched-capacitor resistors, PMOS voltage-to-current converters, an NMOS current mirror, an integrating bucket capacitor, and a clocked regenerative comparator with an SR latch.

v_r_shift.description: Shifted reference voltage representing the effective voltage drop across the reference input V-to-I converter

equation.explanation: Calculates the effective gate-to-source overdrive / linear range voltage for the PMOS voltage-to-current converter in the reference path.
equation.assumptions: PMOS device operating in strong inversion source-follower mode with body tied to source/well.

sky130_expected.reasoning: With nominal threshold |VTHP| of 0.42V in SKY130 and VDD=1.8V, VR=0.65V leaves 0.73V of linear headroom.

v_i_shift.description: Shifted intensity voltage representing the effective voltage drop across the intensity input V-to-I converter

equation.explanation: Determines the effective voltage driving current through the intensity path switched resistor.
equation.assumptions: V_I <= V_R for non-negative optical illumination signals.

sky130_expected.calculation: For dark level (V_I = V_R = 0.65 V): V_I,shift = 1.8 - 0.42 - 0.65 = 0.73 V; For illuminated pixel (e.g. V_I = 0.4 V): V_I,shift = 1.8 - 0.42 - 0.40 = 0.98 V
sky130_expected.reasoning: As pixel intensity increases (bright light), photodiode voltage drops, increasing V_I,shift above V_R,shift.

v_col_max_linear.description: Maximum allowable column voltage for linear voltage-to-current conversion

equation.explanation: Upper boundary on column voltage ensuring the PMOS V-to-I source follower remains turned on and operating in inversion.
equation.assumptions: PMOS threshold voltage is constant without body effect (placed in its own N-well).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Voltages above VDD - |VTHP| turn off the input PMOS device, cutting off the branch current.

r_r_equiv.description: Equivalent switched-capacitor resistance of the reference branch

equation.explanation: Calculates the effective resistance synthesized by the switched capacitor C_cup clocked at frequency f_clk.
equation.assumptions: Non-overlapping clocks with complete charge transfer on each clock phase.

sky130_expected.reasoning: 100 fF switched capacitor operated with 10 ns clock period yields exactly 100 kOhm nominal equivalent resistance.

i_r_ref.description: Average current flowing through the reference switched-capacitor branch

equation.formula: I_R = V_R,shift / R_R = (VDD - |VTHP| - V_R) * f_clk * C_cup
equation.explanation: Average current mirroring into the reference side of the bucket capacitor during steady-state sensing.
equation.assumptions: Current mirror operates in saturation; switched capacitor charge is fully transferred per cycle.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by shifted reference overdrive voltage divided by the equivalent switched-capacitor resistance.

c_h_thermal_noise.description: RMS thermal noise voltage sampled onto the 1 pF hold capacitor

equation.explanation: Thermal kTC noise sampled onto the reference and intensity hold capacitors when SHR and SHI open.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Fundamental thermal noise floor independent of process technology, setting dynamic range limit.

dsm_resolution_lsb.description: Quantization resolution (voltage per count) of the DSM sensing system

equation.explanation: Nominal input-referred intensity resolution achieved by counting over N clock cycles.
equation.assumptions: Linearized first-order delta-sigma modulation over N integration cycles.

sky130_expected.calculation: For N = 100 cycles, V_R,shift = 0.73 V -> V_res = 0.73 V / 100 = 7.3 mV (or for N = 1000, V_res = 0.73 mV)
sky130_expected.reasoning: The counting interval determines the effective number of quantization levels and filter bandwidth.

dsm_output_ones_dark.description: Number of high comparator outputs (M) when pixel is at dark reference level (V_I = V_R)

equation.explanation: When V_I = V_R, V_I,shift = V_R,shift, so M = 0. The comparator output stays low for all clock cycles.
equation.assumptions: Balanced mirror and matching capacitors; symmetric comparator without systematic offset.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_I = V_R = 650 mV -> V_I,shift = V_R,shift = 0.73 V -> M = 0 out of 100 cycles (Out remains low)
sky130_expected.reasoning: At dark reference level, reference current matches intensity current so comparator output remains low.

step3_testbench.description: Transient and DC testbench for the CMOS image sensor DSM sensing circuit in SKY130 verifying hold capacitor sampling, switched-capacitor bias conditions, and Delta-Sigma modulator feedback operation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) Sensing Circuit Testbench (Sky130)
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* === Device Parameter Definitions ===
.param W_xm1=2.0u  L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=2.0u  L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=2.0u  L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=2.0u  L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm5=1.0u  L_xm5=1.0u
.param W_xm6=1.0u  L_xm6=1.0u
.param W_xm7=2.0u  L_xm7=0.15u
.param W_xm8=2.0u  L_xm8=0.15u
.param W_xm9=2.0u  L_xm9=0.15u
.param W_xm10=2.0u L_xm10=0.15u
.param W_xm11=1.0u L_xm11=0.15u
.param W_xm12=1.0u L_xm12=0.15u

* === Power Supply and DC Biases ===
VDD VDD 0 1.8
Vblack Vblack 0 650m
Vinten Vinten 0 650m

* === Circuit Under Test (DUT) ===
xm3 N002 phi1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm1 N004 phi2 N002 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 N006 Out N004 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
C1 N002 0 1e-13
xm4 vbucket VI N006 N006 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
X_U1 vbucket vd4r Out Outi clock VDD 0 SUB_1
xm5 vbucket vd4r 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
C2 vbucket 0 5e-13
xm6 vd4r vd4r 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm7 N001 phi1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm8 N003 phi2 N001 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
xm9 N005 0 N003 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
C3 N001 0 1e-13
xm10 vd4r VR N005 N005 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
Chr VR 0 1e-12
xm11 VR shr Vblack 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
Chi VI 0 1e-12
xm12 VI shi Vinten 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}

* === Subcircuits ===
.subckt SUB_1 inp inm q qi clock VDD GND
  xm1 N003 inp GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Outm Outp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  xm3 Outp Outm VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm5 N002 Outm N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
  xm6 N001 Outp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
  xm4 Outm clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  xm7 Outp clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
  xm8 Outm clock N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm9 Outp clock N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
  xm10 N004 inm 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
  X_U1 Outp q qi VDD 0 NAND_2
  X_U2 qi Outm q VDD 0 NAND_2
.ends SUB_1

.subckt NAND_2 A B Out VDD GND
  xm3 out B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm8 out A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm11 N001 B GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
  xm12 out A N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
.ends NAND_2

* === Control and Clock Signals ===
* Sample-and-hold pulse from 10ns to 100ns
Vshr shr 0 PULSE(0 1.8 10n 0.5n 0.5n 90n 5000n)
Vshi shi 0 PULSE(0 1.8 10n 0.5n 0.5n 90n 5000n)

* Non-overlapping switched-capacitor clocks (T = 10ns, f = 100MHz)
* Active low PMOS precharge phi1 (8.5ns - 9.5ns of each 10ns period)
Vphi1 phi1 0 PULSE(1.8 0 208.5n 0.2n 0.2n 1.0n 10n)
* Active low PMOS charge-transfer phi2 (1.0ns - 4.0ns of each 10ns period)
Vphi2 phi2 0 PULSE(1.8 0 201.0n 0.2n 0.2n 3.0n 10n)
* Comparator evaluation clock (active high from 5.0ns - 8.0ns)
Vclk clock 0 PULSE(0 1.8 205.0n 0.2n 0.2n 3.0n 10n)

.ic v(VR)=0.65 v(VI)=0.65 v(vbucket)=0.6 v(vd4r)=0.6

.control
* Run Transient Simulation (1500 ns total duration as in textbook)
tran 0.1n 1500n uic

* Measure sampled voltages on hold capacitors
meas tran v_sample_r find v(VR) at=150n
meas tran v_sample_i find v(VI) at=150n

* Calculate shifted reference and intensity voltages
let vthp_nom = 0.42
let v_r_shift = 1.8 - vthp_nom - v_sample_r
let v_i_shift = 1.8 - vthp_nom - v_sample_i
let v_col_max = 1.8 - vthp_nom
let r_r_sc = 1.0 / (100e6 * 100e-15)
let i_r_avg = v_r_shift / r_r_sc
let v_resolution_100 = v_r_shift / 100.0

print v_r_shift
print v_i_shift
print v_col_max
print r_r_sc
print i_r_avg
print v_resolution_100

* Measure bucket voltage and modulator output at end of sensing interval
meas tran vbucket_final find v(vbucket) at=1490n
meas tran vd4r_final find v(vd4r) at=1490n
meas tran out_max max v(Out) from=500n to=1500n
meas tran out_avg avg v(Out) from=500n to=1500n

print vbucket_final vd4r_final out_max out_avg
quit
.endc
.end
